values.note: Reservations by phone, (888) 889-7010 or 614-336-6214, or cplccinfo@gmail.com; no online booking. During the National Matches (July-August) lodging goes first to match organizations, teams and competitors, and non-match 'general use' requests open later (May 11 in 2026). Cancel by 2 p.m. the day before arrival (not during the Matches). RV check-out noon.

note: RV park on the Ohio National Guard's Camp Perry training site near Port Clinton (Ottawa Co), open to civilians: each site has a 40x10 ft asphalt pad and a fire ring; secure shower house; pets welcome in the RV park (not in the lodging). Handy for Lake Erie, the islands ferries and Marblehead. --Claude

Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer and phone booking (were note-derived), 40 back-in sites from the RV map, showers/flush toilets/laundry; added the military discount, the National Matches lodging priority and the cancellation/check-out rules.
